guide.title: Connect WhatsApp step by step
guide.hint: Five steps at Meta. The first time takes about twenty minutes.

app.title: Create the Meta app
app.body: In Meta for Developers create an app of the Business type, then add the WhatsApp product to it.

token.title: Create a system user token
token.body: In Meta Business Settings add a system user, give it your WhatsApp account, and generate a token with the permissions. Paste it as the access token below.

values.title: Find each value in the Meta dashboard
values.body: Copy each value into the field with the same name in this form.
values.accountId: WhatsApp Business Account ID: WhatsApp > API Setup. Enter it as the account ID.
values.appId: Find the App ID and the app secret under App settings > Basic.
values.phoneId: Phone number ID: WhatsApp > API Setup. You enter it later when you add the number in the customer messages settings.

webhook.title: Paste the webhook address and verify token
webhook.body: In WhatsApp > Configuration, set the callback URL to the receiving address and the verify token to the one LiwanOS shows you.
webhook.before: After you save the account, LiwanOS shows the address and creates the verify token. Rotate it to see its value once.
webhook.after: The address is under Receiving addresses below. Rotate the verify token to see its value once.

fields.title: Subscribe to the webhook fields
fields.body: Subscribe to the fields LiwanOS processes. The first is required; the others keep templates, forms and number health up to date.
